profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
As my career history demonstrates, I'm a true "unicorn," able to: 
Code: Web Animation, HTML5, CSS3, Wordpress, GSAP (Greensock), jQuery, Javascript, HPUX
Create: Sketch, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Indesign, Dreamweaver, Flash, Fireworks, Premiere Pro, Corel Draw & Painter
UX: Axure, Balsamiq Mockups, Omnigraffle, Principle, Invision
Certifications: UX Certification Nng, DoubleClick Studio Certification, DoubleClick Studio
HTML5 Certification

positions.title: Freelance Graphic Designer/ Photographer
positions.description: Photographer, graphic/web designer & front end developer

positions.title: Associate Web Designer & Creative Developer
positions.description:
•Improve existing in-store display performance by converting Flash animation to jQuery, CSS3, and GSAP code-based animation.
•Concept and code new display content and infrastructure enhancements.
•Support store-opening efforts and assist IT team in troubleshooting and resolving display issues.
•Create static and HTML5-animated web ads.

positions.title: Digital User Interface Designer (Profiles Contractor)
positions.description:
- Designed and coded standards-compliant consumer e-mail marketing campaigns.
- Ensured accuracy of e-mail campaigns by proofreading and testing e-mail layouts prior to launch.
- Created e-mail layouts consistent with client briefs and corporate brand guidelines.

positions.title: Marketing Manager(Web Designer/Graphic Artist/Photographer)
positions.description:
Marketing Manager for Open Plan Systems (HMU, LLC) in Richmond, VA. 
- Designed marketing concepts and publications for print, video, web, and promotional use.
- Redesigned company websites and e-mail campaigns according to branding guidelines. 
- Photographed company products and interior office locations.

positions.title: Associate HR Generalist
positions.description: Managed recruiting/hiring process, high school scholarship program, college recruiting and internship programs; coordinated company training program for US locations.

positions.title: Systems Controller
positions.description: Monitored and performed change management on Unix & Sun Systems in a 24/7 Lean operations center, providing 99.9% availability to worldwide customers by troubleshooting and tracking hardware and software issues.
